_comment: The one table of ALA hosts both config-URL guards classify against: the live audit of
/alaAdmin/viewConfig (e2e/cypress/support/config-audit.ts) and the offline check of the
rendered config before deploy (scripts/config-baseline.py ala-hosts). Kept in e2e/ because
CI mounts only that directory into the Cypress container. Edit it here, never in a copy.
serviceHosts: ALA hosts serving a role we deploy ourselves; a config value pointing at one
means the deployment uses ALA's instance instead of its own. Documentation and content
hosts (www., support., bare ala.org.au) are absent on purpose: they are legitimate links.
familyPattern: ALA-family domains; anything there that is not a service host is informational.
nonProdPattern: ALA test/staging infrastructure; always a finding unless declared.
inertKeyPrefixes: keys never audited. Grails 'environments.<env>.*' blocks are the compiled
per-environment defaults; viewConfig lists them raw, but the value in force is the same key
without the prefix, which IS audited -- so an ALA value there is reported where it applies.
